# Buffer repository instructions

The only current product authority is `docs/V12_1_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md`. Read `AGENTS.md`, `PRODUCT.md`, `PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS.md`, and `DESIGN.md` before analyzing or changing the product.

The public repository is a single current snapshot containing only the V12 direct baseline and V12.1 current product evidence. V2-V11 product documents, retired screenshots, tests, scripts, implementations, branches, tags, and readable history were removed from GitHub and exist only in an owner-held offline Git bundle. Never merge external historical context into the current product shape.

Current released baseline: v0.35.0, four primary spaces (Now, Future, Conditions, Records); REALITY, FORECAST, and SCENARIO are separate; Buffer reflects and never advises. The LLM can only interpret candidate facts. Code validates, the user confirms, and only code commits.

The user approved public-service positioning and full web/Mini Program parity on 2026-10-07, then confirmed unified accounts, automatic cross-platform sync and a free launch without payments/subscriptions. Read `docs/PUBLIC_SERVICE_AND_PARITY_SCOPE.md` and `docs/PUBLIC_SERVICE_PRD.md`. This supersedes the old single-user/stop restrictions. These capabilities and public-release gates are not complete; retain existing password protection. Providers, operating budget and actual platform credentials remain TBD. Do not buy unapproved resources, silently upload old local data or infer authorization for OCR, bank sync, AI Chat, advice, automatic action or unrelated modules.
